Topology is the default view; this is the flat list. The sentence answers “where
did Claude go” for the whole session; “→ show” jumps to the flagged and failed
rows. View and filters live in the URL.
Which sources were present for this session. A missing one reads “Not recorded:
Python scripts — needs hook 2.xx (how to update)”, never an error. The “Not
shown” line names services Claude started and Log Hub’s own uploads; each opens
Flagged only / Failed only are one click. Kind, origin, seen and agent sit
behind Filters ▾ (this view only). Active filters become removable chips shared
● Observed: seen while it ran. ◐ From command: read from the command or tool
call, outcome from its result. ○ Inferred: found in a script Claude wrote, may
never have run. Same glyphs in every view.
search · web page · API / HTTP · git / packages · ssh / files, neutral grey.
Colour is kept for failed (red) and flags (amber) only. MCP calls have no kind
A burst from one command (npm install, 214 requests) folds into one row with its
own totals; click to expand in place. Sorting by another column unfolds it.
Greyed and italic, never counted in “227 requests” or in totals. It explains a
URL found in a script that was not seen on the wire.
Tooltip: “not measured for this kind of access”. Never 0. Size and time are
known only for curl/wget/ssh/scp/sftp and Node.js processes; everything else
shows where, not how much. Totals say how many requests were measured.
Plain sentence names the sources that saw it. The query string is never stored —
the pane says so. Timing bar only when it was measured.
